title: NAILS activate --json
description: Machine-readable activate envelope (contract version 2): exactly one document on stdout. It reports the outcome: a success is printed only once the soft-reboot is enqueued, so a failure to enqueue it is the one document (the error `soft_reboot`, no data, ok false, exit 1) and never follows a success. The soft-reboot then stops every program of the decoy, the reader included, so a reader stopped first may not read the success. The version-1 progress line stream is gone; a window watches progress on its own channel, where activation also reports each advisory (an `advisory` event) before it asks to log the operator out. A success or a success with warnings carries data and is ok; a cancel is the shared cancel shape (an error with the code `cancelled`, no data); a failed entry keeps its data with ok false. ok is true only when the exit code is 0 or 9. An internal error is the error `internal_error`, exit 1.

hidden_system.description: The hidden NixOS toplevel entered, when one was built.

filesystems.description: What happens to each decoy filesystem and swap in the hidden root (read-only, overlaid, masked, skipped), each with why where it is kept off.

masked_units.description: The decoy units masked in the hidden root: the swap and the decoy filesystems it keeps off where no boot target requires them, or where it cannot skip them, and the units that fail or do nothing there (the boot-loader units, systemd-remount-fs.service, systemd-growfs-root.service). A unit a boot target requires that is skipped is not masked and is not listed here: filesystems names it as skipped, and status --json lists it in required_units. The generator masks are not listed.

warnings.description: What the operator should know before using the session: a hidden NixOS system built for another kernel, a decoy mount the way back cannot make again, and the advisories activation reads before it asks to log the operator out, such as hidden sessions' package database no longer following the decoy's (the `package-drift` check), each with its fix on a line of its own. Any warning makes the status `entering_with_warnings` and the exit code 9.

allOf.description: A document that is not ok carries its error: a failure its own code, a cancel the code `cancelled`.
A failed activation is never ok.
